svg.text: Training versus inference: what the fabric sees
Left: bulk-synchronous elephant flows bounded by the tail. Right: many independent north-south requests, latency-bound

g.title: Leaf n (rail n) — all 8 rails in parallel
g.text: Leaf n (rail n) — all 8 rails in parallel

svg.text: 8 elephant flows per node, GB each, all start at the same instant (low entropy: ~8 QPs per node)
all-reduce completes only when the last byte lands on the last GPU

g.title: Needs: non-blocking 1:1, lossless (credits / PFC+ECN), adaptive routing, rail-optimized

svg.text: Needs: non-blocking 1:1, lossless (credits / PFC+ECN), adaptive routing, rail-optimized
Loss = go-back-N retransmit stalls the QP for ms; one 200G port paces 1,000 GPUs
disaggregated serving re-introduces big east-west RDMA flows
one slow request hurts one user, not the cluster

g.title: Needs: north-south capacity + LB, jitter control, NVLink for TP; fabric for KV-cache / PP

svg.text: Needs: north-south capacity + LB, jitter control, NVLink for TP; fabric for KV-cache / PP
Spectrum-X or standard Ethernet typical; InfiniBand for large disaggregated pools
